description: This file defines a React component called ErrorBoundary that catches runtime errors in its child components and displays a fallback UI. It implements error handling lifecycle methods and renders UI for error states.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that acts as an error boundary to catch rendering errors in its child components and display an fallback UI.

methods.name: constructor(props)
methods.description: Initializes state with hasError as false and error as null.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError(error)
methods.description: Static method that updates state to indicate an error has occurred when an error is caught.

methods.name: componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo)
methods.description: Logs error details to the console when an error occurs in child components.

methods.name: render()
methods.description: Renders fallback UI if an error is detected, otherwise renders child components.
